item.srsl.star_remains.desc: Can be found in special structures, but obtaining it is not easy.
item.srsl.star_remains_essence.desc: Can be obtained by smelting `Star Remains` in a furnace.
item.srsl.structure_scroll.desc: Generates a random structure upon use, which may fail.
enchant.srsl.neko_blade.desc: The lower the durability of the weapon the higher the damage increase, up to 1.15x.
enchant.srsl.neko_god.desc: Very low probability of dealing command level damage, probability affected by luck.
enchant.srsl.neko_meow.desc: The attack itself makes a catcall. Nothing more.
enchant.srsl.neko_king.desc: You can use minerals to strengthen your weapon, adding 1 point of damage for every ? points of strengthening.
enchant.srsl.neko_emperor.desc: The number of kills will be recorded, and for every ? kills, 1 point of damage will be added.
enchant.srsl.neko_day.desc: Increases damage during the day and decreases it at night.
enchant.srsl.neko_night.desc: Increases damage at night and decreases it during the day.
enchant.srsl.neko_ninja.desc: Goes into stealth when taking damage and increases damage.
enchant.srsl.neko_soul.desc: Gain souls per attack, and spend 200 souls to heal 10% of your life when wounded.
enchant.srsl.neko_blessing.desc: Gain one tier of blessing per cat bred, reducing by two tiers when the cat dies. Consume one tier of blessing to reduce damage when injured, stackable.
enchant.srsl.neko_mirror.desc: Has a chance to bounce back damage when injured and is immune to this damage.
enchant.srsl.neko_life.desc: Has a probability to mitigate damage greater than 20% of life and less than 150% to 20%.
enchant.srsl.neko_chop.desc: There is a probability of obtaining a biological head
enchant.srsl.e_adaptive.desc: Immune to damage whose source is itself. No other damage taken will exceed 35% of current lifesteal, reduced to a minimum of 3 points.Gain 30s invincibility when near death, damage taken is converted to lifesteal, will not die during this time, cooldown 150 seconds.All of the above expire on cooldown (duration, cooldown are configurable).
enchant.srsl.e_natural.desc: Increases lifesteal by 10 points, and lifesteal is slowly restored
enchant.srsl.e_red_lotus.desc: Applies half the damage dealt to the attacker as Void damage. It also adds a [Karma Fire] effect. Attacking a target with the [Karma Fire] status repairs itself.
enchant.srsl.e_stance.desc: Reduces damage outside of your own touch distance by 80%. Increases damage within touch distance by 70%.
enchant.srsl.e_warlord.desc: Damage taken is increased by 30%.The lower the life value, the higher the damage. Increases damage by up to 75%.Upon death, it is reduced to 3 points of blood and is immune to this death with a cooldown of 100 seconds.
enchant.srsl.e_angel.desc: Incidental magic damage, plus an additional 50% if the target is a hostile creature.
enchant.srsl.e_cross.desc: Deals an additional 100x weapon damage to bats.
enchant.srsl.e_gan_jiang.desc: If the sidearm holds a weapon with an enchanted [MoYe], there is a probability of triggering a KILL.
enchant.srsl.e_mo_ye.desc: If the sidearm wields a weapon with an enchanted [GanJiang], there is a chance to trigger a KILL.
enchant.srsl.e_judgment.desc: If the target has less than 2x weapon damage in life it is simply executed.
enchant.srsl.e_mahogany.desc: Deals additional void damage to zombies (configurable).
enchant.srsl.e_zen_stick.desc: Applies a [YanLing] effect to non-undead creatures and a [Transcendence] effect to undead creatures.Attacks in the [YanLing] state do not deal damage.This effect can't be canceled if it reaches 18 levels.
enchant.srsl.z_confusion.desc: Attacked creatures treat other creatures nearest to the player as targets
enchant.srsl.zi_bright.desc: Monsters avoid it when holding it.
enchant.srsl.zi_alone.desc: Only this enchantment provides a damage bonus that varies with the number of times it is used.
enchant.srsl.zi_indestructible.desc: Prevent destruction when in a dropped state.
enchant.srsl.zi_unbreakable.desc: Use NETHERITE BLOCK at the Anvil to strengthen it five times to unlock it.
enchant.srsl.tori_no_uta.desc: When there is a feather in the offhand,Increase arrow speed
enchant.srsl.chain_harvesting.desc: Collect all identical squares within range
enchant.srsl.curse_disease.desc: Gain random negative effects when attacking
enchant.srsl.corrode.desc: Attacks have a chance to lose half of their current durability
item.srsl.revelation_stone.tooltip: Right click to reveal an enhancement
